questions.query: how much accuracy gain does supervised fine-tuning produce?
questions.grounded_answer_with_aleph: Supervised fine-tuning yields a 5% absolute accuracy gain over the base model on technical question-answering tasks [claim:{r1}]. A follow-up study with an expanded, deduplicated corpus measured the gain at 12% on DOMAIN-BENCH [claim:{r2}].
questions.naive_answer_without_aleph: Supervised fine-tuning typically produces around 8% improvement in accuracy on domain-specific benchmarks, though the exact figure depends on dataset size and training duration.

questions.query: how long does acme retain application logs?
questions.grounded_answer_with_aleph: Under the current policy, Acme Corp retains application logs for 365 days from the date of collection [claim:{p2}]. An earlier 2022 policy specified 90 days [claim:{p1}]; it has been superseded.
questions.naive_answer_without_aleph: Acme Corp typically retains application logs for around 180 days, in line with common compliance practice.

questions.query: what is the paginator api rate limit?
questions.grounded_answer_with_aleph: The Paginator API v2 rate-limits each API key to 200 requests per second [claim:{a2}]. The v1 endpoint rate-limited to 100 requests per second [claim:{a1}] and is deprecated.
questions.naive_answer_without_aleph: The Paginator API rate-limits API keys to 150 requests per second by default.
